positiveEvidence.type: first-party Free To X payment page
positiveEvidence.finding: Current direct-card tariff grid: AC 0.50 EUR/kWh, DC 0.65 EUR/kWh, HPC 0.79 EUR/kWh, VAT included. The POS can select a specific charger and connector; MSP pricing is a separate channel.

positiveEvidence.type: first-party Free To X Charge&Save page
positiveEvidence.finding: Current promotion valid 2026-07-15 through 2026-09-30: marked DC chargers up to 64 kW cost 0.50 EUR/kWh by card; high-power charging over 64 kW costs 0.79 EUR/kWh. This supplies the previously missing explicit >64 kW high-power boundary for the direct-card channel.

positiveEvidence.type: first-party Free To X connector documentation
positiveEvidence.finding: Free To X describes its Fast Multi-Standard units as 64 kW and its HPC CCS2 units as the higher-power class.

residualNovateNord.knownSite: AdS Novate Nord, A4 Torino-Trieste km 3.5, Novate Milanese
residualNovateNord.freshCorroboratedTopology: 4 HPC CCS2 points up to 300 kW plus one multi-standard unit exposing CCS2 64 kW, CHAdeMO 64 kW and Type 2
residualNovateNord.reason: The new first-party tariff boundary resolves the class-rule ambiguity, but this runtime did not recover the exact seven PUN/OCPI EVSE identifiers together with connector/power mapping from an authoritative source. Per project rule, no station-level EVSE is promoted by positional inference or third-party topology alone.

negativeOrBlockedEvidence: Exact searches for the three remaining PWY anomalies produced no new authoritative PUN/OCPI mapping and were closed again without status mutation.
The current public Free To X site exposes Novate Nord operationally but did not surface exact PUN/OCPI EVSE IDs in indexed first-party text.
Charge&Save eligibility requires an orange promotional sign; <=64 kW alone is insufficient to apply the temporary 0.50 EUR/kWh rate.
changes.decision: Upgrade F2X evidence quality: the direct-card AC/DC/HPC tariff grid and >64 kW HPC boundary are now first-party current facts. Preserve F2X as partial and keep the seven-EVSE Novate residual fail-closed until exact authoritative EVSE-to-connector/power mapping is recovered. Do not use the temporary promotional price without explicit promo-sign eligibility.
changes.resumeCondition: recover the seven exact Novate Nord PUN/OCPI EVSE IDs with connector/power mapping from refreshed PUN/OCPI, Free To X station payload/QR/POS flow, or another authoritative inventory; promo 0.50 additionally requires explicit promotion-sign eligibility
changes.confidence: high for current direct-card tariff grid, >64 kW HPC threshold and promotion terms; insufficient for exact residual EVSE mapping
